title: Active delivery topology checkpoint and serialized reintegration plan
primary_claim: The inspected active delivery and research branches are classified without mutating refs, and each inspected delivery area has exactly one proposed serialized integration line or an explicit experiment-only non-integration boundary.

findings: PR #240 still contains the useful #229 scheduler ancestry but is 39 commits ahead and 107 behind current main; direct history merge is not the gardening choice
PRs #258, #260, #262, #265 and #267 are current-main lines with zero behind count at observation time
PR #255 is isolated experiment evidence and is one main commit behind
Ikarus is split into two Git lines: #257 -> #259 -> #263 and main -> #264 -> #266
comparing #263 to #264 gives a current-main merge base with #264 six commits ahead and twenty-three commits behind #263, so the stacks are siblings rather than one contained chain
local linked worktrees cannot be observed from the GitHub remote API and therefore remain unknown
